items.label: FIGURE 1.10
items.title: Comparison of rural and urban poverty rates, 2022
items.content: The figure consists of two donut charts comparing the share of the global poor in rural and urban areas at two different poverty lines. Legend: Rural (dark blue), Urban (gold). Panel a: Share of global poor at $2.15. The chart shows a larger proportion of the global poor at this poverty line reside in rural areas, with Sub-Saharan Africa being the largest segment, followed by South Asia and East Asia and Pacific. Panel b: Share of global poor at $6.85. The chart shows a more balanced distribution between rural and urban areas compared to panel a, with South Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa being the dominant regions for both rural and urban poor.
